headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Kris Statlander vs. Taya Valkyrie fought tooth and nail for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.75. It was the 20th time the AEW TBS Title had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
